content_sections.heading: CUH Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CUH Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CUH Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CUH Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 1 for Finance Officer, 1 for Controller of Examinations, and 1 for Internal Audit Officer.

content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Finance Officer & Controller of Examinations: Master's degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent. At least 15 years experience as Assistant Professor in Academic Level 11 and above or 8 years in Level 12 and above including Associate Professor with educational administration experience, or comparable research/higher education experience, or 15 years administrative experience with 8 years as Deputy Registrar. Internal Audit Officer: Officers holding analogous post on regular basis from AG/CAG or Audit & Accounts Services, or 2 years regular service in Level 11, or 5 years in Level 10 from Central/State Govt, Universities, autonomous organisations with relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Finance Officer: Preferably below 57 years. Controller of Examinations: Preferably below 57 years. Internal Audit Officer: Preferably below 56 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Ex-Servicemen/regular employees of Central/State Govt/Central Universities. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Finance Officer: Level-14 (Group A) Controller of Examinations: Level-14 (Group A) Internal Audit Officer: Level-12 (Group A)

content_sections.heading: CUH Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Written Test Skill Test Interview Document Verification

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CUH Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CUH to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Central University of Haryana recruitment is 07 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Finance Officer, Controller of Examinations, and Internal Audit Officer in the Central University of Haryana recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Finance Officer and Controller of Examinations posts?
faq.answer: For the Finance Officer and Controller of Examinations positions, candidates must possess a Master's degree with at least 55% marks and have significant administrative or teaching experience as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Internal Audit Officer post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Internal Audit Officer post is preferably below 56 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per government rules for eligible categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Finance Officer and Controller of Examinations posts is Level-14 (Group A), while for the Internal Audit Officer, it is Level-12 (Group A).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for General and OBC categories. SC, ST, and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications for CUH Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a Written Test, Skill Test, Interview, and Document Verification. Specific details may vary and are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this recruitment on a deputation basis?
faq.answer: Yes, the job type for these positions is deputation, meaning eligible government officials can apply to serve in these roles.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF for CUH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page or by visiting the official website of the Central University of Haryana.
